name: seven-row-upper-bound-tail-analysis
question: do the K0332-style chord-energy + Melchior refinements (that improved (5,7) from 200 to 158) improve the K0318 upper bounds U_{7,q} = 1142/862/708/651?
method: exact integer LP over the K0318 triple budget with (a) the K0318 cross-row pair cap, (b) the Melchior-inversion per-stone y-cap (same derivation as K0332 sec.3), (c) a chord-pair event audit using the sharp K0342 energy E_r; pure TypeScript, exhaustive integer optimization over y

families.immune: H = 2Q/d0 = 702 exactly (integer, achieved at y=0); any y-cap is irrelevant
H = 2Q/d0 = 644 exactly (integer, achieved at y=0); any y-cap is irrelevant

chord_event_audit.zero_event_profiles_available: q=5/6/7: type-0 (2,1,1,..)/(1,1,..) and type-1 (2,1,..)/(1,..) all have k2<=1 (0 events); q=8 type-0 forced k2>=2 by pigeonhole+mod9 with profiles (2,2,2,1)/(2,2,1,1,1) (>=1 event) but 705 >> 322 (triple cap); q=8 type-1 (2,1,1,1,1) has 0 events
chord_event_audit.conclusion: chord-pair events never bind at w=7; the K0332 (5,7) success relied on profile forcing (2+2+2 / 2+2+1) which disappears at 6 external rows

mod9_7row_facts: type-1 blocker circles (2 points p,s in the target row => 2-point row) must fully miss >=1 of the 6 external rows as lattice points (external stones occupy <=5 rows)
type-0 circles with a 2-stone row cannot have lattice points on all 6 external rows (p in L makes 7 rows)
at q=8 (r=7 > 6) no non-horizontal line blocker exists (<=1 point per external row, <=6 < 7); all type-0 q=8 blockers are circles
next_avenue: reduce the triple budget Q itself: triples whose determined circle has lattice points on all 7 rows and a 2-point row are mod9-impossible as blockers and can be removed from the usable budget; a universal lower bound on the number of such excluded triples (adversary minimization) is unimplemented
promotion: NOT promoted to a knowledge item: the only improvements (1142->1140, 862->853) are negligible against witness lower bounds 34/30; K0318 remains the canonical upper bound
